o.text: Possibly from Proto-Turkic *kay- (“to turn back; to show respect; to squint; to move to smb.'s side; to run towards; to go past, around”). Cognate with Karakhanid قَدِتْماقْ (qadïtmāq, “to come back”), Turkish kayıtmak, Crimean Tatar qaytmaq, Bashkir ҡайтыу (qaytıw).
From the same source as çırpmaq, ultimately from Proto-Turkic *čap-.
